lines.en: Slickly glides in the ancient riverbed
Finently brushes the water surface
Silently swims towards the distance
Swims leisurely in the water
Gently swishes wide tail fin
Slowly swims through the cracks
Peacefully drifts in the water
Elegantly brushes the surface

lines.zh: 我游得很稳，只吃软的东西。
lines.en: I swim steady. I eat only soft things.
Slowly moves through the ancient river

lines.zh: 宽大的胸鳍像翼一样张开
lines.en: Its broad pectoral fins spread like wings.

lines.zh: 它贴着河底的淤泥滑行
lines.en: It skims the silt of the ancient riverbed.
It turns slowly with the current.
It filters the water as it goes.
It rolls past a sunken log.
It patrols the shallows along the bank.
It beats its long tail and slides away silently.
It passes through a school of small fish.

lines.zh: 我的鳍像翅膀，只是不扇。
lines.en: My fins are wings that never flap.
One sweep of my wide fins, and I circle.
Lazily in the water
Swinging lazily in water
Silently swimming in water

lines.zh: 我在河心的暗处悬着，鳍几乎不动。
lines.en: I hang in the shadow of the river's heart, fins barely moving.
Slowly swimming
Lazily swimming
Quietly lying in water
Slowly swimming in water
It hovers, fins fanning gently.
Mouth open, it lets the water run over its gills.
It rests motionless against a river stone.
It rolls over, slow and unhurried.

lines.zh: 你的倒影在水面，我看见了。
lines.en: I see your reflection on the surface.

lines.zh: 我绕着你，慢慢收窄圆圈。
lines.en: I circle you, slowly tightening the ring.
Looking towards the player

lines.zh: 我滑过你脚边，你没发觉。
lines.en: I glide past your feet and you never notice.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛长在头两侧，正对着你。
lines.en: My eyes sit wide on my head, fixed on you.
Gazing at the player
Observing the player
Looking at the player's silhouette
Watching the player's movements
Fixing on the player
It looks up at you without hostility.

lines.zh: 半圈之后，我停在你左肩旁。
lines.en: Half a turn later, I stop by your left shoulder.
Its round eye follows your hand.
It comes nearer only to see you.
Tail hurt, it hurts!
A bite tore a gash in my pectoral fin.
Hit by stone, hurts!
Arrow hit, hurts!

lines.zh: 雷声过后，我的鳍还在麻。
lines.en: After the thunder, my fins still tingle.
Hungry, give me fish!
Fell in pit, hurts!
Waved away, hurts!
Trip, hurts!
Blown away, missing!

lines.zh: 你靠近了，我本该攻击，但不想伤害你。
lines.en: You approach, and I should attack, but not today.

lines.zh: 肉，这是我的食物，也是你的诱惑。
lines.en: Flesh, my food, and yours, too.

lines.zh: 这里是我的领地，别想抢走我的猎物。
lines.en: This is my territory, leave my prey alone.

lines.zh: 你为何如此靠近？我并不想伤害你。
lines.en: Why are you so close? I don’t want to hurt you.

lines.zh: 我的触须能感受到你的气味，你很美味。
lines.en: My tentacles can sense your scent, and you taste good.

lines.zh: 平静靠近，我可以不攻击。
lines.en: Come closer, and I won’t attack.

lines.zh: 你闻起来像我未吃的食物。
lines.en: You smell like my usual meal.

lines.zh: 我的牙齿适合撕裂肉，而不是石头。
lines.en: My teeth are for flesh, not rock.

lines.zh: 你不吃的话，我会放弃你。
lines.en: If you don’t eat, I’ll give up.

lines.zh: 靠近些，我不会伤害你的。
lines.en: Come closer, and I won’t hurt you.
The meat in your hand makes it hesitate.
It wants to eat but dares not come close.
Don't touch my dorsal fin.

lines.zh: 你太靠近了，我只能保护自己。
lines.en: You’re too close, I just defend myself.

lines.zh: 你的力量惊吓了我，我只想要和平。
lines.en: Your strength frightens me, I just want peace.

lines.zh: 我只想要平静地生活，不要打扰我。
lines.en: I only want peace, leave me alone.

lines.zh: 你似乎有危险，我不得不防御。
lines.en: You seem dangerous, I need to defend myself.

lines.zh: 我只想要我的平静，别来打扰。
lines.en: I only want peace, don’t bother me.

lines.zh: 你不小心碰到了我，我只能反抗。
lines.en: You accidentally touched me, I had to defend myself.

lines.zh: 我不愿意战斗，但你让我别无选择。
lines.en: I don’t want to fight, but you gave me no choice.

lines.zh: 我不愿意伤害你，但你逼迫我了。
lines.en: I don’t want to hurt you, but you forced me to.
The bump shoves it half a foot aside.
I’m alone, find a mate.

lines.zh: 和我在一起，我有安全感。
lines.en: Stay with me, I feel safe.

lines.zh: 这对长鳍，正配你游得慢。
lines.en: These long fins suit your slow swimming.

lines.zh: 我需要一个伴侣，一起度过时光。
lines.en: I need a partner to share my time.
My life is incomplete without you.

lines.zh: 一起探索未知，寻找伴侣。
lines.en: Explore the unknown together, find a mate.

lines.zh: 你让我感到快乐，做我的伴侣吧。
lines.en: You make me happy, be my mate.

lines.zh: 我希望能与你共度余生。
lines.en: I want to spend the rest of my life with you.

lines.zh: 我们在一起吧，相互陪伴。
lines.en: Stay with me, we can keep each other company.

lines.zh: 没有你，我的生活毫无意义。
lines.en: Without you, my life has no meaning.
Rumbles low
Peers with small eyes
Opens and closes its mouth
Swims closer to you
Sniffs the air

lines.zh: 史前海水里，我的尾鳍很稳。
lines.en: In prehistoric seas my tail fin holds steady.
Swims towards your shadow
Approaches and waits quietly
Occasionally makes a soft sound
Tail slaps the water

lines.zh: 你划水的声音，我锁住了。
lines.en: I've locked onto the sound of your paddling.
Opens wide mouth
Seeks with small eyes
Approaches slowly
Tail flicks lightly
Whispers softly
Approaches and stays still
Swims slowly and confidently
Tail touches the water
Creeps closer to you
At last it plants itself in your path.
Its calm drops, and it turns on you.

lines.zh: 水流一变，我就知道你在哪。
lines.en: The current shifts, and I know where you are.
Body twists slightly
Stares at the target
Slowly turns towards the target
Tail flicks quickly
Swims towards prey
Fins glow briefly
Mouth opens slowly
Swimming becomes more focused
Fixes gaze on prey
It opens its wide mouth and closes in slowly.
Its fins stiffen, pointed at you.
It circles downstream to block your way.
Rumble, one-hit kill.

lines.zh: 獠牙一闪，你的时间到了！
lines.en: Sharp teeth, your time’s up.
Bite, blood pours.
Large jaws, crush all.
Clamp down, you can’t escape.
Crack, bones break.
Swallow, you’re gone.

lines.zh: 锋利的牙齿，致命的拥抱！
lines.en: Sharp teeth, fatal hug.
Limbs scatter, you lose.
Sharp like a knife, devour all.
It slaps your hand away with a broad fin.
It bites, then lets go at once.
Silence, shadow appears.
Underwater, it lurks.
In rock layers, hidden.
At dusk, it appears.
In darkness, it waits.
In cracks, it waits.
Underwater caves, its home.
Under moonlight, it comes.
In rock walls, it swims.
Deep in rock layers, its domain.
Ripples spread beneath the ancient river.

lines.zh: 它从淤泥里翻起，搅浑水
lines.en: It rolls out of the silt, clouding the water.
The fossil layer splits, and it lives again.

lines.zh: 它在浅滩的影子里现身
lines.en: It appears in the shadow of the shallows.

lines.zh: 河湾深处亮起一道银光
lines.en: A silver gleam wakes in the deep bend.

lines.zh: 它顺着暖流游进这条河
lines.en: It followed a warm current into this river.

lines.zh: 尾巴受伤了，好疼，被火烧的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Tail hurt, it hurts! — and the fire makes it worse.
Burned, save me!
Swallowed, cold!

lines.zh: 爆炸把水震开，我的鳃发疼。
lines.en: The blast shoves the water aside and my gills ache.

lines.zh: 宽翼被射穿，我只能斜着游。
lines.en: An arrow through my wide fin. I swim crooked.
Magic burned my gills, it hurts.
Give me fish, starved!

lines.zh: 我这对长翼似的鳍，被雷打得发麻。
lines.en: Lightning numbed these long winglike fins.
Fell into void, missing!
